channel.title: FXStreet Forex & Commodities News
channel.description: Real-time Forex News and the latest trading updates. Stay updated on the latest news about currencies and commodities markets.

item.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD slides below $60 as sellers retain control
item.description: Silver (XAG/USD) remains under pressure on Thursday even as the US Dollar (USD) and US Treasury yields ease. Sellers remain in control after a break below the $60 psychological mark, with the Relative Strength Index (RSI) drifting toward oversold territory.

item.title: Mexican Peso: Watching support for reversal signal against US Dollar – Societe Generale
item.description: Societe Generale analysts report USD/MXN has extended its rebound after reclaiming the 200-day moving average near 17.40 and posting an interim high around 18.43. A brief pullback is underway, with attention on whether a base forms for a more durable reversal. First support at 17.68 and the 200-DMA at 17.40 are key downside levels to monitor.

item.title: Gold gains modestly as US Treasury yields ease, Fed hike risks linger
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) holds modest gains on Thursday as a retreat in US Treasury yields tempers the US Dollar’s (USD) strength, helping the metal regain some ground. However, Gold lacks bullish conviction and remains in a bearish consolidation phase near two-month lows.

item.title: Euro steadies as US yields retreat, traders assess Fed and ECB signals
item.description: EUR/USD rebounds during American trading hours on Thursday as a pullback in US Treasury yields tempers the US Dollar’s (USD) momentum. However, France’s fiscal concerns and broader US Dollar strength keep the Euro (EUR) pinned near the 17-month low touched earlier this week.

item.title: Germany: Gradual recovery with energy risks – Deutsche Bank
item.description: Deutsche Bank Research’s Germany Blog analyses August hard data, highlighting volatile one-offs in construction and manufacturing but more encouraging fundamentals.

item.title: Canadian Dollar: Consolidation near 1.42s against US Dollar – Scotiabank
item.description: Scotiabank strategists Shaun Osborne and Eric Theoret highlight that USD/CAD around 1.4269 shows signs of consolidation after a sharp Canadian Dollar (CAD) weakening since early September. Price action is closely tracking the 2-year US–Canada spread, with Oil offering some support to CAD.

item.title: European Central Bank: Neutral communication with upside inflation risks – Nordea
item.description: Nordea’s Chief Analyst Jan von Gerich interprets the ECB’s September monetary policy account as supporting further rate hikes, likely in December and March. The Governing Council remains focused on upside inflation risks, especially from persistent energy shocks and resilient growth.

item.title: Federal Reserve: More hikes ahead after October pause - UOB
item.description: UOB’s Alvin Liew analyzes the September 2026 FOMC minutes, highlighting unanimous support for a 25bp hike to 3.75–4.00% as inflation stays elevated and growth remains solid.

item.title: BoE’s Bailey calls for stronger financial markets to absorb future shocks
item.description: Bank of England (BoE) Governor Andrew Bailey said on Thursday that financial markets need to be better prepared for future shocks and monetary policy must stay focused on bringing inflation back to target.

item.title: Euro: French debt risk weighs on EUR against US Dollar – ING
item.description: Chris Turner at ING highlights that EUR/USD remains fragile as French sovereign debt volatility drives the pair. A report suggesting the French Treasury may shorten issuance duration unsettled investors, who fear reduced pressure on politicians to deliver fiscal consolidation. ING continues to favor a dip in EUR/USD towards the 1.1100/1.1120 area, where stronger technical support may emerge, with French fiscal debates only starting mid-October.

item.title: ECB expected to pause in October before hiking rates in December – Reuters poll
item.description: The European Central Bank (ECB) is expected to leave interest rates unchanged in October before delivering another increase in December, according to a Reuters poll conducted October 5-8.

item.title: US Initial Jobless Claims dropped to 197K last week
item.description: According to a report from the US Department of Labour (DOL) released on Thursday, the number of US citizens submitting new applications for unemployment insurance decreased to 197K for the week ending October 3.

item.title: Europe: Sovereign stress and China trade tensions – Rabobank
item.description: Rabobank’s RaboResearch Global Economics & Markets team underscores renewed pressure in European sovereign yields and rising political-economic tensions with China. The report notes sharp moves in French, Italian and Greek bonds and discusses Europe’s struggle with Chinese hybrid vehicle imports.

item.title: Euro slips against British Pound on France’s fiscal concerns, central bank signals
item.description: EUR/GBP struggles to attract buyers and edges lower on Thursday, remaining on the back foot for a tenth consecutive day as France’s political and budget concerns keep the Euro (EUR) under pressure against major currencies. Traders also assess central bank remarks from both sides of the Channel.

item.title: Canadian Dollar nears 18-month lows as risk aversion buoys the US Dollar
item.description: The Canadian Dollar (CAD) posts marginal losses on Thursday with the safe-haven US Dollar (USD) favoured by the risk-averse mood, as tensions in the Middle East boost Crude prices and the global bond selloff extends.

item.title: United Kingdom: GDP momentum seen slowing – Deutsche Bank
item.description: Deutsche Bank Research, led by Chief UK Economist Sanjay Raja and economist Maui Brennan, nowcasts UK GDP flat in August 2026 after a strong July. They expect services to rise slightly, with declines in production and construction.

item.title: ECB Accounts: Upside risks surrounding inflation outlook
item.description: The accounts of the European Central Bank's (ECB) September policy meeting showed that all members viewed the risks surrounding the inflation outlook as being to the upside, as reported by Reuters.

item.title: ECB officials agree: Eurozone is still saved from second-round inflation effects
item.description: The Euro (EUR) is down 0.16% to near 1.1178 against the US Dollar (USD) during the European trading session on Thursday. The major currency pair faces selling pressure as the US Dollar outperforms due to surging United States (US) bond yields.

item.title: Romanian Leu: Policy on hold as politics weigh – Societe Generale
item.description: Societe Generale expects no change from the NBR, keeping the policy rate at 6.50% as political deadlock in Bucharest and Romanian Leu weakness offset the sharp fall in inflation. The bank notes Headline CPI has dropped markedly on base effects. It highlights ongoing government formation uncertainty and warns that prolonged turmoil could jeopardize Romania’s Investment Grade rating.

item.title: Polish Zloty: Dovish hold with limited tightening – ING
item.description: ING economists Rafal Benecki and Adam Antoniak note that the National Bank of Poland kept its reference rate at 3.75% in October, as expected, with inflation driven mainly by fuel prices.

item.title: Indian Rupee remains on track to revisit all-time low
item.description: The Indian Rupee (INR) traded mildly higher against the US Dollar (USD) on Thursday due to possible Reserve Bank of India’s (RBI) intervention. According to a Reuters report, Indian central bank likely sold US dollars near the market open on Thursday to support the Indian rupee, four traders said.

item.title: British Pound: Euro weakness drives Sterling gains - MUFG
item.description: Lee Hardman at MUFG highlights that the Pound has rallied sharply against the Euro as Euro-zone fiscal concerns intensify, driving EUR/GBP to fresh year-to-date lows.

item.title: Euro: ECB Account seen reinforcing hike case – BBH
item.description: Brown Brothers Harriman’s (BBH) Elias Haddad highlights that EUR/USD trades heavy below 1.1200 ahead of the ECB Account release. Above-target Eurozone inflation and a firmer growth outlook give the ECB scope for further tightening, limiting divergence with the Fed.

item.title: Swiss Franc retreats further as SNB vice chairman hints at lower-for-longer rates
item.description: The Swiss Franc (CHF) loses ground for the fourth consecutive day against the US Dollar (USD) on Thursday, as the Swiss National Bank vice chairman discarded any change to the bank's monetary policy despite growing risks from the War in Iran.

item.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD slides to fresh two-month low below $59 as US yields eye more gains
item.description: Silver price (XAG/USD) posts a fresh two-month low at around $58.50 during the European trading session on Thursday. The white metal faces intense selling pressure as United States (US) bond yields eye more upside on the back of recovery signs in oil prices.

item.title: China: PBoC rules out competitive Yuan devaluation to boost trade
item.description: The People's Bank of China (PBoC) said on Thursday that China has neither the need nor the intention to depreciate the Chinese Yuan (CNY) to gain a competitive advantage in international trade, according to a statement reported by Reuters.

item.title: Swiss Franc: Range trading holds for now against US Dollar – UOB
item.description: UOB strategists Quek Ser Leang and Lee Sue Ann note that USD/CHF price action has been quiet, with the pair expected to stay confined intraday between 0.8310 and 0.8345. Over a 1–3 week horizon, they reiterate that USD/CHF has likely entered a range-trading phase between 0.8245 and 0.8365. On a 1–3 month view, they see scope for further rebound but limited momentum to revisit the July peak.

item.title: Swiss National Bank sees no need to change rates despite Iran risks
item.description: Swiss National Bank (SNB) Vice Chairman Antoine Martin sees no need to adjust monetary policy at this stage, as inflation remains within the central bank's 0%-2% price stability range. item.title: Japanese Yen: Breakout to set direction against US Dollar - Societe Generale
item.description: Societe Generale strategists Morning Briefing highlight USD/JPY’s sharp rebound from a September low near 152.90, with the pair now capped by key moving averages. They note a sideways pattern between 156.35 and 159, with a break of this range set to confirm direction.

item.title: Gold Price Forecast: XAU/USD recovery falters as Oil and yields rise
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) ticks up on Thursday, trading at the $4,125 area after bouncing up from two-month lows at $4.066 on Wednesday.
